summary: Compugen Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K reporting Q2 2026 financial results and a corporate update on its clinical pipeline. The filing includes an earnings press release, unaudited financial statements, and MD&A, incorporated by reference into its F-3 shelf registration. No M&A, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situation event is described. The content is routine periodic financial reporting by a foreign private issuer, with no transaction terms, board recommendations, or unusual corporate actions. The filing is classified as None because it does not constitute a special situation.
